findings.claim: `npm --prefix .claude/hooks run check:dist` cannot pass because the script points to a file that is not added by this change.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 5.1 requires verifying `npm --prefix .claude/hooks run check:dist` passes, but `.claude/hooks/package.json` defines `"check:dist": "node scripts/check-dist.mjs"` and the diff contains no `.claude/hooks/scripts/check-dist.mjs` file.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `.claude/hooks/scripts/check-dist.mjs` or remove/replace the script with an implemented check.

findings.claim: The TypeScript source tree is incomplete and `npm --prefix .claude/hooks run build` will fail because source files import modules that are only present in `dist/`.
findings.evidence: `.claude/hooks/src/agent-ledger.mts` imports `./lib/hook-io.mjs` and `./lib/paths.mjs`, and other src files import `./lib/paths.mjs`, but the diff adds only `.claude/hooks/dist/lib/hook-io.mjs` and `.claude/hooks/dist/lib/paths.mjs`; no `.claude/hooks/src/lib/hook-io.mts` or `.claude/hooks/src/lib/paths.mts` hunks are present.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the missing `.claude/hooks/src/lib/hook-io.mts` and `.claude/hooks/src/lib/paths.mts` sources and ensure the TypeScript build emits the committed dist files.

findings.claim: Flush advances the cursor before the session note is safely written and queued, so a write/rename/outbox failure permanently drops ledger entries from future flushes.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 3.1 requires the cursor-based ledger delta to be summarized, written to `.prometheus/raw/`, and queued under `.prometheus/outbox/`; however `flush()` calls `writeCursor(root, end)` immediately after scanning, before `writeFileSync(tmp, text)`, `renameSync(tmp, note)`, and `writeFileSync(path.join(outbox, name), text)`.
findings.suggested_fix: Move `writeCursor(root, end)` until after the raw note and outbox entry have both been successfully persisted; for scan-blocked notes, only advance the cursor if intentionally discarding the blocked delta is the desired behavior and document that.
